0022600171.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-2, 1-1 on the road) come in on a one-game losing streak, sitting 5th in the East and 3rd in the Atlantic, 2 games back, with Jakob Poeltl (shoulder inflammation), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture) all out. The LA Clippers (1-5, 0-4 on the road) have lost five straight and sit 13th in the West, and they are missing Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), Max Strus (plantar fasciitis), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), while Derrick Jones Jr. (knee) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Toronto lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 119-94 in Los Angeles on March 25, and this is the first meeting of the 2026-27 season.
